appearance.languageHint: Defaults to your system language; change anytime

updateRestart.message: Version {{latestVersion}} has been downloaded (current {{currentVersion}}). Restart Vetta now to apply the update, or choose "Later" to be reminded next launch.

login.openFailed: Couldn't open your browser. Please try again.
login.rejected: This authorization link is no longer valid. Please sign in again.

actionApproval.whyConfirm: The AI is requesting this action. It will run only after you confirm.
actionApproval.genericSummary: Please confirm whether to allow this action.
actionApproval.genericImpact: Confirm to run it. Reject cancels the request without changing your data.
actionApproval.unreadableRequest: This request could not be fully parsed. If you are unsure, reject it and ask the AI to explain.

toggle.stateOnHint: When on, related capabilities are available. Existing settings are kept.
toggle.stateOffHint: When off, usage is paused. Settings stay so you can turn it back on anytime.
toggle.editableHint: You can flip this before confirming

mcp.enableSummary: Once on, the AI can use this MCP's capabilities in chat (browse the web, call external tools, etc.).
mcp.disableSummary: Once off, this MCP pauses and cannot be used in chat. Configuration is not deleted.
mcp.enableImpact: This MCP becomes available immediately for later chats.
mcp.disableImpact: This MCP pauses immediately. Settings remain; nothing is uninstalled.

skills.enableSummary: Once on, the AI can use this ability (skill/scene) in chat when needed.
skills.disableSummary: Once off, this ability will not be used. Files are not uninstalled.
skills.enableImpact: The ability becomes available for use in chat.
skills.disableImpact: The ability is paused. Configuration and files remain.

plugins.enableSummary: Once on, this plugin's UI and capabilities become active again.
plugins.disableSummary: Once off, the plugin pauses. It is not uninstalled.
plugins.enableImpact: Plugin features apply to the app immediately.
plugins.disableImpact: Plugin features pause immediately. Install and settings remain.

im.enableSummary: Once on, you can chat with the AI through Feishu, WeChat, and other external channels.
im.disableSummary: Once off, external IM channels can no longer reach the local AI.
im.enableImpact: The IM bridge runs with current settings; external messages can enter chat.
im.disableImpact: New IM messages stop arriving. Existing sessions remain.

webhook.enableSummary: Once on, notifications can be sent to this webhook (e.g. DingTalk / Feishu bot).
webhook.disableSummary: Once off, no more messages are pushed to this address. URL and secrets remain.
webhook.enableImpact: This channel can receive notifications and test messages.
webhook.disableImpact: This channel pauses. Configuration is not deleted.

general.notifications.enableSummary: Once on, task completion and update events can show as system alerts.
general.notifications.disableSummary: Once off, the app will not show system notifications.
general.notifications.enableImpact: Matching events will show system notifications.
general.notifications.disableImpact: System notifications stop. In-app status remains visible.

set-binding.title: Change shortcut
set-binding.summary: Pick a feature, then click the key area and press a new combo. It applies right after you confirm.
set-binding.impact: You can trigger this feature with the new combo. Conflicting bindings will fail to save.

reset-binding.title: Restore default shortcut
reset-binding.summary: Put this feature’s shortcut back to the system default.
reset-binding.impact: This feature will use its default key combo again.

reset-all-bindings.title: Restore all default shortcuts
reset-all-bindings.summary: Clear custom shortcuts for the features below and restore defaults.
reset-all-bindings.impact: Global feature shortcuts return to defaults. Quick Panel summon and after-send stay the same.
reset-all-bindings.warning: Does not change how you open the Quick Panel, or whether send opens the main window.

set-quick-panel-trigger.title: Change Quick Panel summon
set-quick-panel-trigger.summary: Choose which key to double-tap to open the Quick Panel. “Disabled” means you’ll use the main window instead.
set-quick-panel-trigger.impact: Applies immediately. You can change it again anytime.

set-quick-panel-behavior.title: Change after-send behavior
set-quick-panel-behavior.summary: After you send from the Quick Panel, open the main window to follow up, or keep running in the background.
set-quick-panel-behavior.impact: Only affects chats you start later from the Quick Panel.

shortcuts.bindingSectionDescription: Same as Settings → Shortcuts. Pick a feature, then record a key combo.
shortcuts.comboFieldHint: Click, then press the new combination to record
shortcuts.quickPanelTriggerSectionDescription: Same options as on the Shortcuts settings page.
shortcuts.quickPanelBehaviorSectionDescription: Same as “after-send behavior” on the settings page.

quickPanelTriggerHints.none: Turn off double-tap summon; use the main window when needed
quickPanelTriggerHints.mod: Double-tap ⌘ (Mac) or Ctrl (Windows) anywhere to open the panel
quickPanelTriggerHints.alt: Double-tap ⌥ / Alt anywhere to open the panel
quickPanelTriggerHints.shift: Double-tap ⇧ anywhere to open the panel

quickPanelBehaviorHints.foreground: After send, open the main window on the new chat
quickPanelBehaviorHints.background: After send, close the panel and keep the chat running in the background

set-default.title: Set default chat model
set-default.summary: Choose the model used by default for new chats. You can change it below before confirming.
set-default.impact: New chats will prefer this model. Existing chats keep their current model.

upsert-provider.title: Create or Update Provider Confirmation
upsert-provider.summary: Review the provider configuration. Secret fields are masked; confirmation writes the submitted config.
upsert-provider.impact: Provider config will be written to local models.json and affect available models.

remove-provider.title: Remove Provider Confirmation
remove-provider.summary: Models under this provider will become unavailable and default model references will be cleared.
remove-provider.impact: This provider and its models will be removed from local config.
remove-provider.warning: Removing a provider also clears default model references that depend on it.

models.defaultSectionDescription: Same as Settings → Models. Takes effect after you confirm.

upsert.title: Create or Update MCP Server Confirmation
upsert.summary: Review the MCP server configuration. Secret headers are masked.
upsert.impact: MCP server config will be written to local mcp.json and may affect agent tools.

set-enabled.title: Enable/Disable MCP Server Confirmation
set-enabled.summary: Change whether this MCP server is enabled.
set-enabled.impact: The MCP server enabled state will update immediately.

remove.title: Remove MCP Server Confirmation
remove.summary: The MCP server configuration will be removed locally.
remove.impact: This MCP server config will be removed locally.
remove.warning: You will need to reconfigure the MCP server to restore it.

mcp.envPlaceholder: One KEY=VALUE per line; fill secrets here yourself
mcp.headersPlaceholder: One HeaderName=value per line; fill secrets here yourself

set-enabled.title: Enable/Disable Ability Confirmation
set-enabled.summary: Change whether this ability (skill/scene) is enabled.
set-enabled.impact: Ability enabled state takes effect immediately.

uninstall.title: Uninstall Ability Confirmation
uninstall.summary: Local ability files will be removed. This cannot be undone.
uninstall.impact: Local ability files will be uninstalled and cannot be restored easily.
uninstall.warning: Ability files will be removed. This cannot be undone.

install-from-market.title: Install Ability from Market Confirmation
install-from-market.summary: Download and install this ability (skill or scene) from the market.
install-from-market.impact: The ability will be downloaded and appear on the Abilities page, enabled by default.

create.title: Create Project Confirmation
create.summary: Create a new project and add it to the sidebar.
create.impact: A new project will be created in the sidebar and the directory ensured.

open.title: Open Project Confirmation
open.summary: Open the project at the specified path.
open.impact: The project path will open and join the active list.

rename.title: Rename Project Confirmation
rename.impact: Only the sidebar display name changes; disk path is untouched.

archive.title: Archive Project Confirmation
archive.summary: Move the project to the archive list. Session history is kept.
archive.impact: The project moves to the archive list; session history is kept.

unarchive.title: Unarchive Project Confirmation
unarchive.summary: Restore the project to the active list.
unarchive.impact: The project returns to the active list.

remove.title: Remove Project Confirmation
remove.summary: Remove the project from the list without deleting files on disk.
remove.impact: Remove the sidebar entry only; project files on disk are not deleted.
remove.warning: Only the sidebar entry is removed; project files on disk are kept.

projects.pathOptional: Optional; omit to create under workspace by name

set-notifications.title: Change notification settings
set-notifications.summary: Choose whether system notifications are allowed.
set-notifications.impact: Task and update alerts will show or hide based on the new setting.

set-execution-mode.title: Change default permissions
set-execution-mode.summary: Choose the default permission level for new chats. You can change it below.
set-execution-mode.impact: New chats will use this permission. Existing chats stay as they are.

set-workspace.title: Change default workspace
set-workspace.summary: New projects will be created under this folder by default.
set-workspace.impact: The default workspace path updates. Existing projects stay in place.

general.notificationsTargetHint: Task completion, updates, and similar alerts
general.executionModeSandboxHint: Limits where files can be changed. Safer for everyday use.
general.executionModeFullAccessHint: Allows broader file and system actions. More capable, higher risk.

set-experimental.title: Change experimental features
set-experimental.summary: You can adjust these experimental toggles before confirming.
set-experimental.impact: Matching capabilities will turn on or off. Experimental features may be unstable.

agent.experimentalSectionDescription: Same toggles as Settings → Agent. You can adjust them before confirming.

experimentalFields.vettaCliDesc: Allow calling local capabilities from the terminal via Vetta CLI
experimentalFields.promptPredictionDesc: Suggest possible follow-up text while typing; may use a little quota
experimentalFields.agentSkillsDesc: Allow the agent to use extended skill capabilities

create.title: Create Knowledge Base Confirmation
create.impact: A new knowledge base will be created.

rename.title: Rename Knowledge Base Confirmation
rename.impact: The knowledge base display name will update.

delete.title: Delete Knowledge Base Confirmation
delete.summary: The knowledge base and its processed data will be removed. This cannot be undone.
delete.impact: The knowledge base and processed data will be deleted.
delete.warning: Deleting a knowledge base also removes processed artifacts. This cannot be undone.

add-files.title: Add Files to Knowledge Base Confirmation
add-files.summary: Add the selected files and start processing.
add-files.impact: Selected files will be added and enter processing.

delete-entry.title: Delete Knowledge Entry Confirmation
delete-entry.summary: Delete the specified entry from the knowledge base.
delete-entry.impact: The knowledge base entry will be deleted.
delete-entry.warning: Deleted entries cannot be restored from the app.

scan-now.title: Scan Knowledge Base Now Confirmation
scan-now.summary: Trigger one knowledge base scan and processing cycle.
scan-now.impact: One knowledge scan and processing cycle will start immediately.

retry-failed.title: Retry Failed Knowledge Tasks Confirmation
retry-failed.impact: Failed/quarantined records will be cleared and reprocessed.

set-processing.title: Change knowledge processing settings
set-processing.summary: You can edit these knowledge base options before confirming.
set-processing.impact: Automatic knowledge processing will follow the new settings.

knowledge.processingSectionDescription: Same options as Settings → Knowledge. Only fields in this request are shown.

processingFields.enabledDesc: When off, automatic processing pauses. Existing knowledge is not deleted.
processingFields.pollIntervalDesc: How often to check for files that need processing
processingFields.processingModelDesc: Model used to read and organize documents
processingFields.agentConcurrencyDesc: More parallel jobs is faster but uses more resources
processingFields.ocrConcurrencyDesc: How many image text-recognition jobs run at once

set-language.title: Switch language
set-language.summary: UI text will switch to the selected language.
set-language.impact: Menus, settings, and buttons switch immediately. Chat content is unchanged.

set-enabled.title: Enable/Disable Plugin Confirmation
set-enabled.summary: Change whether this plugin is enabled.
set-enabled.impact: Plugin enabled state will update immediately.

install-from-url.title: Install Plugin from URL Confirmation
install-from-url.summary: Download and install the plugin from the given URL.
install-from-url.impact: The plugin will be downloaded and installed from the URL.

install-from-path.title: Install Plugin from Local Path Confirmation
install-from-path.summary: Install the local zip, grant declared permissions once, and enable the plugin.
install-from-path.impact: The local plugin package will be installed, granted its declared permissions, and enabled.

uninstall.title: Uninstall Plugin Confirmation
uninstall.summary: The plugin and its local data will be removed according to policy.
uninstall.impact: The plugin will be uninstalled according to policy.
uninstall.warning: Plugin and its local data may be cleared according to policy.

set-enabled.title: Enable/Disable IM Gateway Confirmation
set-enabled.summary: Change whether the IM sidecar gateway is enabled.
set-enabled.impact: IM gateway enabled state will update.

restart.title: Restart IM Gateway Confirmation
restart.summary: Restart the local IM sidecar process.
restart.impact: The local IM gateway process will restart.

set-agent-model.title: Set Claw model
set-agent-model.summary: Choose the model used for external IM (Claw) chats. Same picker as Settings.
set-agent-model.impact: Later chats from Feishu/WeChat use this model. Leave empty to follow the default.

set-feishu-config.title: Configure Feishu credentials
set-feishu-config.summary: Enter App ID and secrets below. Fill secrets yourself; do not rely on the AI to pass them.
set-feishu-config.impact: Local Feishu bridge credentials will be updated. Empty secret fields keep existing values.

im.channelHint: Connect external chat channels such as Feishu and WeChat
im.feishuHint: Fill App Secret and other secrets below yourself
im.modelSectionDescription: Same as Settings → Claw. Supports model and reasoning level.
im.modelKeyHint: Leave empty to clear a dedicated model and fall back to the default

create.title: Create Webhook Confirmation
create.summary: Review the webhook configuration. Signing secrets are masked.
create.impact: A new webhook endpoint config will be saved.

update.title: Update Webhook Confirmation
update.summary: Review the webhook fields that will be written.
update.impact: Webhook config will update for submitted fields.

set-enabled.title: Enable/Disable Webhook Confirmation
set-enabled.summary: Change whether this webhook is enabled.

delete.title: Delete Webhook Confirmation
delete.summary: The webhook configuration will be permanently removed.
delete.impact: Webhook config will be permanently deleted.
delete.warning: Deleted webhook config cannot be recovered.

test.title: Test Webhook Confirmation
test.summary: Send a test message to this webhook.
test.impact: A test message will be sent to this webhook.

send.title: Send Webhook Message Confirmation
send.summary: Review the message that will be sent through the webhook.
send.impact: A custom message will be sent to this webhook.

cancel.title: Cancel download
cancel.summary: This will stop the file download.
cancel.impact: The download stops immediately. Partial files may remain depending on status.
cancel.warning: You will need to download again for a complete file.

check.title: Check for Updates Confirmation
check.summary: Check whether an application update is available.
check.impact: The app will check for available updates.

download.title: Download Update Confirmation
download.summary: Start downloading the available update package.
download.impact: Download of the update package will start.

install.title: Install Update Confirmation
install.summary: Install the downloaded update. The app may need to restart.
install.impact: The update will install and the app may restart.
install.warning: Installing an update usually requires restarting the app. Save your work first.

dismiss.title: Dismiss Update Prompt Confirmation
dismiss.summary: Temporarily dismiss the current update prompt.
dismiss.impact: The current update prompt will be dismissed temporarily.

cancel.title: Cancel Update Download Confirmation
cancel.impact: In-progress update download will be cancelled.

manageApproval.secretPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep existing secret / no change

navigationApproval.title: Open page
navigationApproval.summary: The AI wants to open the following page. Confirm to switch there.
navigationApproval.impact: The app will switch to that page. Your data will not be changed.

schedulerApproval.createDescription: Review the scheduled task configuration. After confirmation, the task will be saved and scheduled according to its enabled state.
schedulerApproval.updateNotFound: Current scheduled task was not found, so the full configuration cannot be loaded.
schedulerApproval.updateLoadFailed: Failed to load current scheduled task configuration.
schedulerApproval.deleteDescription: Deleting a scheduled task also removes all execution records for that task. This action cannot be undone.
schedulerApproval.deleteWarning: If the task is currently running, abort it before deleting.
schedulerApproval.enableDescription: After enabling, the scheduled task will run automatically according to its Cron expression.
schedulerApproval.disableDescription: After disabling, the scheduled task will no longer run automatically, but its configuration and history are kept.
schedulerApproval.runNowDescription: Trigger one execution of the scheduled task immediately without waiting for the next scheduled time. The task will run with its current prompt and parameters.
schedulerApproval.abortDescription: Abort the currently running scheduled task agent. Execution will be interrupted, and generated output will be kept.
schedulerApproval.abortWarning: Aborting immediately terminates the agent run, so the current execution state may be incomplete.

batchTasksApproval.projectLoadNotFound: Current batch project was not found, so the full configuration cannot be loaded.
batchTasksApproval.projectLoadFailed: Failed to load current batch project configuration.
batchTasksApproval.projectCreateSummary: Review the batch project configuration. After confirmation, one subtask will be created for each source folder.
batchTasksApproval.projectUpdateSummary: Review the batch project changes to write. The confirmation UI has merged the current configuration and will only append new source folders.
batchTasksApproval.projectDeleteSummary: Confirm whether to delete this batch project, all subtasks, session state, and task artifacts. This action cannot be undone.
batchTasksApproval.projectFullAccessWarning: Tasks will run with full access and may read or modify files inside and outside the selected folders. Confirm that the prompt and folders are trusted.
batchTasksApproval.notFoundInCurrentList: Not found in the current list
batchTasksApproval.projectNotFoundInCurrentList: Project not found in the current list
batchTasksApproval.taskNotFoundInCurrentList: Task not found in the current list
batchTasksApproval.projectDeleteWarning: This permanently deletes the project directory, all task records, session state, and task artifacts. The operation will be rejected if tasks are running or queued.
batchTasksApproval.resumeTextLabel: Additional message to send to the original session
batchTasksApproval.taskRunSummary: Confirm whether to create a session for this pending subtask and start running it.
batchTasksApproval.taskRunDescription: Create a session for this pending task and start running it.
batchTasksApproval.taskRetrySummary: Confirm whether to clear the old result for this subtask and rerun it from the start.
batchTasksApproval.taskRetryDescription: Clear old results and rerun this task from the start.
batchTasksApproval.taskRetryWarning: Old sessions, state, and existing artifacts in the task directory will be deleted and cannot be restored.
batchTasksApproval.taskStopSummary: Confirm whether to abort or remove this subtask and clean its session, state, and artifacts.
batchTasksApproval.taskStopDescription: Abort running or queued tasks and reset the state to pending.
batchTasksApproval.taskStopWarning: The current session, run state, and existing artifacts in the task directory will be deleted.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteSummary: Confirm whether to permanently delete this subtask and its related data from the project.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteDescription: Permanently remove this task from the project.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteWarning: Task records, project subdirectory, session state, and artifacts will be permanently deleted.
batchTasksApproval.taskResumeSummary: Confirm whether to send "Continue" to the paused original session and keep existing context.
batchTasksApproval.taskResumeDescription: Send "Continue" to the paused original session while keeping existing context and artifacts.
batchTasksApproval.taskResumeWithTextTitle: Resume Batch Subtask with Message Confirmation
batchTasksApproval.taskResumeWithTextSummary: Confirm the additional message to send to the paused session. Existing context will be kept.
batchTasksApproval.taskResumeWithTextDescription: Send the additional message to the paused original session, then continue execution.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteSessionSummary: Confirm whether to delete the conversation session associated with this subtask. Task records and task directories are kept.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteSessionDescription: Delete the conversation session associated with this task.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteSessionWarning: Session history cannot be restored. Task records and task directories will not be deleted.
batchTasksApproval.resetFailedPartialWarning: Only tasks currently in the Failed state will be processed. Other task IDs will be ignored.
batchTasksApproval.executionDeleteAllSummary: Confirm whether to delete all non-running subtasks in this project. Running tasks will be kept.
batchTasksApproval.executionDeleteAllDescription: Delete all non-running tasks in the project. Running tasks will be kept.
batchTasksApproval.executionDeleteAllWarning: Queued tasks will be removed from the queue, then task records, session state, and artifact directories will be permanently deleted.
batchTasksApproval.executionStartSummary: Confirm whether to start executing this batch project. Pending and paused tasks will enter the execution flow.
batchTasksApproval.executionStartDescription: Queue all pending tasks and resume paused tasks. Completed or failed tasks will not rerun.
batchTasksApproval.executionStopSummary: Confirm whether to stop unfinished tasks in this project and clean related sessions, state, and artifacts.
batchTasksApproval.executionStopDescription: Stop all unfinished tasks in the project while keeping completed tasks.
batchTasksApproval.executionStopWarning: Queued, running, failed, and paused task sessions, state, and artifact directories will be cleaned and reset to pending.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetTitle: Clear and Rerun Batch Project Confirmation
batchTasksApproval.executionResetSummary: Confirm whether to clear all task state and artifacts in this project and rerun the whole project immediately.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetDescription: Clear the entire project execution state and artifacts, then rerun all tasks immediately.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetWarning: All task sessions, state, and artifact directories will be deleted, including completed tasks. This action cannot be undone.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetFailedSummary: Confirm whether to clean the selected failed tasks. Only tasks currently in the Failed state will be processed.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetFailedDescription: Clean selected failed tasks. If the project is still running, they will be queued immediately; otherwise they return to pending.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetFailedWarning: Old sessions, error state, and existing artifacts for the selected failed tasks will be deleted.
